principles_applied: Prefer one boring deterministic compiler over a pipeline of disjoint heuristic scripts
Cache external Overpass geometry once in staging to eliminate redundant network roundtrips
Use O(1) indexed route-number and directional lookup instead of O(N*M) quadratic iteration
Deprecate legacy SQL RouteIntelligence fallbacks in favor of the clean canonical transit core
Preserve O-TRAVELZ truth invariants: inferred shortest road path is NEVER VERIFIED_ROUTE_GEOMETRY

classifications.issue: C5.1 only audited relation tags (87 relations) without downloading and assembling their actual ordered way geometries for product polyline emission.
classifications.resolution: Fetch and cache full way member geometries for all matched CRUT/Mo Bus relations into a single deterministic cache, assembling contiguous LineStrings by endpoint node connectivity.

classifications.issue: Shortest-road routing between anchors must never be labeled VERIFIED_ROUTE_GEOMETRY, and candidate stops must never be upgraded or given first-mile access.
classifications.resolution: Enforce strict 3-tier grading: VERIFIED_ROUTE_GEOMETRY (only authoritative OSM relation / surveyed transit way), HIGH_CONFIDENCE_ROUTE_GEOMETRY (bounded arterial highway / high-confidence corridor road path), MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_ROUTE_GEOMETRY (inferred road-network path between verified/bounded anchors).

classifications.issue: Forward and backward/alternate sequences have distinct stop sequences and frequently run along one-way road pairs or different avenues (e.g. Master Canteen vs Station Plaza).
classifications.resolution: Key all compiled geometry strictly by canonical sequence_id (e.g. rt_crut_10_forward, rt_crut_10_backward). Do not collapse directions into a single unoriented line.

classifications.issue: Route geometry was previously assembled via fragmented scratch scripts (test_route_geometry.py, prototype_c5_1.py, apply_c5_1_engine.py).
classifications.resolution: Unify all geometry resolution into scripts/compile_c5_route_geometry.py as a single self-contained, reproducible compiler that reads canonical inputs and emits staging artifacts in one run.

classifications.component: Local Geometry Cache vs Live Overpass Calls
classifications.issue: Querying Overpass on every compiler run causes rate-limiting, network flakiness, and non-deterministic builds.
classifications.resolution: Persist full OSM relation geometries in data/transport/staging/ama_bus/osm_odisha_bus_relations_cache.json. Compiler runs 100% offline from local staging artifacts.

classifications.issue: Matching 164 sequences against 87 relations with regex/text similarity inside nested loops is O(N*M).
classifications.resolution: Build a hash map keyed by normalized route ref (e.g. lstrip(0) -> 08 -> 8), filtering candidates in O(1) before directional terminal matching.

classifications.issue: Ponytail might suggest omitting per-segment metadata and emitting only sequence-level polylines to save LOC and JSON payload size.
classifications.resolution: REJECT. Segment-level metadata (1,327 segments) is essential for fail-closed gap suppression, transparent truth audit, contributor queues, and first-mile safety gating.
